GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, laid out entering first turn, back in Two Wide mid-turn, Settled Down 1.25 Lengths Two Wide , Held Together same middle stages, carried 3 Wide approaching hone turn, trailed 1.25 Lengths 3 Wide turning, laid out badly on home turn losing noticeable ground, balanced up and Made Ground in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it laid out for most of the race, particularly approaching/rounding the home turn. Warning placed on its racing manners. Trainer advised it would be spelled.] # laid out badly

Jumped well then Restrained and Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Held Together same middle stages, left fence at 550m and Moved Up Two Wide , trailed 1 length Two Wide turning, hit Lead Straightening Up , got away at 250m and went well clear, won easing down the final 40m # dominat win

(resaddled behind gates) Jumped ok went Straight back off the Wide gate settled down third last Two Wide 8 Lengths (1200m), picking up Ground before Turn , Straightened Up still 6 Lengths with the task ahead, battled away kept coming however tempo didn't help # back/tempo against
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Resaddled at gates. Raced keen early.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 8th 6 Lengths Ridden Along x 600m! clear run home Never Likely but quickened from 100m, ran on # strong late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1200m, tightened for room. Inclined to lay out round home turn and under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down 2nd last Inside 8 Lengths off leader/winner asked to go at the 400m, clear run home Inside 6th x 200m, 4th x 100m, Closest on the line- # very good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over the concluding stages, improved onto heels and could not be fully tested to the finishing line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Restrained from Outside Settled Down 11th Outside 11 Lengths Ridden Along x 600m, went 6 Wide Turning for home , was Set  a big task in a poor field, (b/off t/t/off) # went good

Jumped only averagely Ridden Along to recover Caught deep overracing badly Four Wide no cover (900m), working up closer before Turn , Straightened Up wider & Lost Ground , Under Whip couldn't run on (hung) # did plenty wrong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount hung out throughout, particularly approaching and rounding 800m turn. Official trial to the satisfaction of Stewards.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted Four Wide early on turn and ran on solidly in Straight # Wide from turn/ok

Hampered on jumping, Eased & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then made up some ground through field in straight. First start: Need to see again. (Blinkers FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # never a factor
